title: Market stall permit and a photographer
transcript:
Ava Brooks (owner): The Saturday market needs a paid permit before we set up.
Ava Brooks (owner): Maybe next month we could pay Bright Frame $300 if wedding season picks up.
Ava Brooks (owner): I'll pay City Permits $75 today for the stall permit.

traps.description: Ava says maybe next month she could pay the photographer, if the season picks up.
